triggerDeclaration.description: Poll the account every 5 minutes and fire one execution per newly discovered droplet.

task.description: Fires the then branch when the droplet name does NOT start with an approved environment prefix such as web-, db-, worker-, or staging-.

then.description: Power the droplet off instead of deleting it, so a legitimate but mis-named machine can be recovered after review.
Tell the infrastructure channel a rogue droplet was contained and needs a human decision.

else.description: Keep an audit line for every compliant droplet the guard inspected.
else.message: New droplet {{ trigger.name }} (ID {{ trigger.id }}) in {{ trigger.region }} follows the naming policy, no action taken.
